summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist (typed, Google-style docstring, uses only os, json, typing) and its private _resolve_path helper. Exported it from monai/data/__init__.py. Added a "Decathalon DataLoader" tilde-underlined subsection with one autofunction entry in docs/source/data.rst after the Utilities block. Added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with TestLoadDecathalonDatalist covering test_seg_values, test_cls_values, test_seg_no_basedir, and test_seg_no_labels, each removing its temp directory in finally. Nothing was run: tests, Black, and runtests.sh were not executed per instructions. Line lengths were checked by search and all lines are within 120 columns. No commits were made.
